description: This file defines the EditTitleDialogFragment class, a dialog fragment used for editing the title of a note within the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It manages user input, branding, and communication with the parent activity or fragment.

classes.name: EditTitleDialogFragment
classes.description: A dialog fragment for editing the title of a note, handling user input, branding, and callback to the parent activity or fragment.

classes.name: EditTitleListener
classes.description: An interface that must be implemented by the calling activity or fragment to receive the edited title.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Attaches the fragment to a context, retrieves the old title from arguments, and sets up the listener.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and configures the dialog for editing the title, including setting up branding and input fields.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Shows the keyboard for the title input when the activity is created.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the dialog fragment with the provided title.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles to the dialog.
